svg.aria-label: A pool allocator: equal slots, with the free ones linked through their first bytes; allocating takes the head and freeing pushes the slot back, so the last freed slot is reused first
svg.title: A pool allocator: equal slots, with the free ones linked through their first bytes; allocating takes the head and freeing pushes the slot back, so the last freed slot is reused first
svg.text: Free slots hold a pointer to the next free slot. Allocate takes the head. Free puts a slot back as the head.

g.text: free slot 4: it becomes the head, 4 -> 5 -> 7
allocate: takes slot 4, the one freed last
